task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to the right arm holds the yellow and black code scanner, the left arm grabs the light beige tea-box, and scans the light beige tea-box with the yellow and black code scanner.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，右臂握住黄黑码扫描器，左臂抓住浅米色茶盒，用黄黑码扫描器扫描浅米色茶盒。
